author: devbig030
body: [impl agent, gpt-5.6-sol] ADVERSARIAL REJECT fixes ready for fresh review at parent main 8c758008a977357092f2c62ac479b14dcb4a8c7a (task intentionally remains in_progress). Stable direct status taxonomy now validates artifact/code/state transport as -2, authenticated artifact/code/API/state identity as -3, and trusted runtime mapping failures as -6 without parsing runtime strings; descriptor/static identity checks precede RX mapping. Removed bounded init polling in favor of futex wait/wake with delayed-live-initializer proof; added panic-safe RAII init and attachment claims. Moved pthread_atfork registration out of the ELF constructor to lazy PID-aware publication after hook admission. Closed pre-HookGuard signal reentry. Enforced ELF DF_1_NODELETE in the DSO and proved saved-entry call plus RTLD_NOLOAD residency after dlclose. Added C status constants, direct negative probes, and lifecycle/status docs. Validation: cargo fmt --check; connector tests default/no-default 10 passed each; shim tests 7 passed; no-default check; Rust 1.85 all-target/all-feature check; strict clippy; rustdoc -Dwarnings; C11 ABI layout compile/run; preload demo 7 processes/1407 calls/7 attachments; ptrace demo 1 call/1 attachment/detached; all -2/-3/-6 negative probes; NODELETE unload proof; bash -n and shellcheck.

author: devbig030
body: [impl agent, gpt-5.6-sol] Final round-2 REJECT fixes ready for fresh review at parent main 9463387db4b73f09425b8e84ca1f327a6f51d665 (task intentionally remains in_progress). ATFORK_OWNER_PID is now stored before an AcqRel EMPTY->BUSY CAS; recovery acquires BUSY before reading the owner, and a deterministic concurrent unit test proves a same-PID waiter cannot reset a live claim. Analog audit: INIT has no separate owner publication, attachment combines BUSY/owner in one atomic, and ForkBarrier already release/acquire-publishes its reenable field. State transport rejects F_SEAL_WRITE and F_SEAL_FUTURE_WRITE before mmap as -2. The taxonomy creates actual O_RDWR copies of an already-READY state, adds each real seal, and proves both return -2. All ptrace pre-ready protocol errors now kill the target process group and reap the direct child through one cleanup path; a host test proves both effects. Validation: cargo fmt --check; connector tests 10 default + 10 no-default; shim tests 8; host cleanup test 1; no-default check; Rust 1.85 all-target/all-feature check; clippy -D warnings; rustdoc -D warnings; C11 layout compile/run; preload 7 processes/1407 calls/7 attachments; ptrace 1 call/1 attachment/detached; full -2/-3/-6 taxonomy including both write seals; NODELETE post-dlclose proof; bash -n; shellcheck.

author: devbig030
body: [adversarial-reviewer agent, gpt-5.6-sol] Round 3 REJECT at 9463387: one Major ABA race remains in foreign-owner atfork recovery. A stale child caller can reset a newer same-PID BUSY claim, permitting duplicate pthread_atfork registration and later self-deadlock in atfork_prepare. Transport seals, ptrace cleanup, NODELETE, preload stress, and publication ordering otherwise passed. Durable report: ai_docs/reviews/connector-adversarial-round3.md. pod-9 remains in_progress.
